questions.question: A properly adjusted flat mirror should let the driver see:

options.text: The rear tires touching the ground.
The front tires touching the ground.
Only the roadway and no parts of the bus.
The front bumper.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rear tires touching the ground.
questions.explanation: A properly adjusted flat mirror on a school bus lets the driver see 200 feet behind the bus, the base of each rear wheel, and the sides of the bus.

questions.question: Your vehicle's final position should be:

options.text: Exactly where the examiner has instructed it to be.
Within five feet of the final position described by the examiner.
Wherever you can safely park.
Within two feet of the final position described by the examiner.

questions.correctAnswerText: Exactly where the examiner has instructed it to be.
questions.explanation: Park your vehicle in the exact position the examiner describes. Not following the examiner's instructions exactly can result in losing points or failing the basic control skills test.

questions.question: The area to the left of a school bus is especially dangerous to students because:

options.text: The sun's reflection obscures the left side of the bus.
Passing vehicles are located to the left of the bus.
It is difficult to see the left side of any bus.
There is no door on the left side of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing vehicles are located to the left of the bus.
questions.explanation: All sides of a school bus have danger zones. The left side is especially dangerous because passing vehicles travel on that side.

questions.question: If asked to back your vehicle into an alley, you should first:

options.text: Pull directly into the alley parking space.
Turn your vehicle to the right to position yourself directly in front of the alley.
Pull past the alley and stop perpendicular to the outer boundary.
Pull past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary.
questions.explanation: For an alley docking maneuver, first pull past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary. Then back your vehicle straight into the alley parking area, keeping it within the parking space lines.

questions.question: When asked to change lanes during the skills test, you should:

options.text: Make the necessary traffic checks first.
Not use your mirrors.
Cut off other vehicles if needed to follow the instructions.
Not make the lane change if you don't want to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make the necessary traffic checks first.
questions.explanation: You will make multiple lane changes during the driving skills test. Before changing lanes, check traffic and use proper signals. Change lanes smoothly and safely.

questions.question: During a bus evacuation, students should be led at least ____ away from the road.

options.text: 10 feet
20 feet
50 feet
100 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 100 feet
questions.explanation: If you must evacuate a school bus, lead students at least 100 feet away from the road in the direction of oncoming traffic. This protects them from flying debris if another vehicle hits the bus.

questions.question: After students unload at a school, the driver should:

options.text: Assume students have taken all of their belongings with them.
Assume the students have immediately cleared the doorway.
Walk through the bus and check for any sleeping or hiding students.
Turn off the dispatch radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk through the bus and check for any sleeping or hiding students.
questions.explanation: After students exit at a school, walk through the bus to check for any students who may be sleeping or hiding. Also look for items students may have left behind.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, you may be asked to:

options.text: Pull forward into a parking space.
Drive in a figure eight.
Alley dock.
Sound your horn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alley dock.
questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: A school bus must be evacuated if:

options.text: The bus has stalled in winter weather conditions.
The air conditioning system has broken.
There is any imminent danger of collision.
Students are getting motion sickness.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is any imminent danger of collision.
questions.explanation: It is usually safest for students to stay on a school bus during emergencies. Evacuation is required if the bus is on railroad tracks, is on fire, has a hazardous materials spill, or if there is imminent danger of collision.

questions.question: The front of an enclosed trailer should:

options.text: Be swept clean.
Contain rags.
Not be used for cargo.
Be free of cracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be free of cracks.
questions.explanation: When inspecting an enclosed trailer for the vehicle inspection test, check the front area for damage such as cracks, bulges, or holes.

questions.question: If a student drops an item near a stopped bus, they should:

options.text: Run and pick up the item quickly.
Leave the item behind.
Ask the driver to pick up the item.
Ask another student to pick it up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ask the driver to pick up the item.
questions.explanation: Students should not pick up dropped items because they could be hit by the bus. The student should move away from the bus, get the driver's attention, and ask the driver to pick up the item.

questions.question: During the pre-trip vehicle inspection test:

options.text: You do not need to identify the ABS.
Windshield wipers do not need to be checked.
Shock absorbers only need to be checked on one axle.
The steering box should be checked for leaks.

questions.correctAnswerText: The steering box should be checked for leaks.
questions.explanation: During the pre-trip vehicle inspection test, you must check that the steering box is mounted securely and is not leaking.

questions.question: If a bus has outside convex mirrors, they will be located:

options.text: Below the outside flat mirrors.
Above the outside flat mirrors.
Next to the door.
On top of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Below the outside flat mirrors.
questions.explanation: Outside convex mirrors are located below the outside flat mirrors. They help you see traffic, clearance, and students around the bus.

questions.question: During the on-road driving test, poor lane usage includes:

options.text: Not driving over curbs or sidewalks
Stopping behind crosswalks
Driving in the leftmost lane when more than one lane is available
Finishing a right turn in the rightmost lane

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving in the leftmost lane when more than one lane is available
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, stay in the rightmost lane unless it is blocked. Do not go over curbs, sidewalks, or lane markings. Stop behind stop lines and crosswalks. Make turns in the proper lane.

questions.question: During the on-road driving test, you must do all of the following, except:

options.text: Wear your safety belt.
Obey all traffic laws.
Complete the test without a moving violation.
Obey traffic signs and signals only when other traffic is present.

questions.correctAnswerText: Obey traffic signs and signals only when other traffic is present.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, you must drive safely. This means wearing your safety belt, obeying all traffic signs and signals at all times, obeying all traffic laws, and avoiding accidents and moving violations.

questions.question: When exiting a bus during the basic vehicle control skills test, you must:

options.text: Keep both hands on the handrail.
Not touch the handrail.
Hold the handrail firmly.
Go down the stairs quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the handrail firmly.
questions.explanation: When exiting a bus during the test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. Hold the handrail firmly. Exiting incorrectly may result in automatic failure.

questions.question: When stopped at a railroad crossing while operating a school bus, you should:

options.text: Count on hearing an approaching train.
Rely only on signals to tell you if a train is coming.
Open the door and listen for a train.
Move forward right after a train passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Open the door and listen for a train.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, do not rely only on signals. Ask all passengers to be quiet, open the front door, and look and listen for trains. After a train passes, check both directions for other trains before crossing.

questions.question: If your vehicle has a cargo lift, you should ensure that:

options.text: The lift is loosely attached.
The lift is not leaking.
The lift is fully extended.
The lift is the proper color.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lift is not leaking.
questions.explanation: Check the cargo lift for leaks, damage, or missing parts. The lift must be fully retracted and locked securely.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, you may be asked to:

options.text: Alley dock.
Parallel park to your right.
Parallel park to your left.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: During the on-road test, you will be evaluated on traffic checks. You should not:

options.text: Scan the road for pedestrians.
Check traffic regularly.
Skip checking your mirrors near intersections.
Check your mirrors regularly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Skip checking your mirrors near intersections.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, check for traffic and use your mirrors often, especially at intersections. Look for pedestrians in areas where they may be walking.
